results.title: From $0 to $10k MRR: A 2026 Indie Hacker Playbook | Rethink Lab
results.snippet: - Raising Capital too Early: Don't give up equity to solve a problem that just requires more sales calls. VC money often kills indie hacker businesses by forcing 'growth at all costs.' - Premature Scaling: Don't hire a marketing agency or a full-time developer until you have hit at least $5k MRR and have a clear, repeatable process for acquiring customers.
